Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Construcții, Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com
 About The Team
 You'll join the team responsible for authentication and identity across Bitdefender's consumer ecosystem: sign-in, account management, and the token and session services that Bitdefender applications, devices and partner integrations depend on. Security and availability are core requirements for every change we ship.
We're looking for someone methodical, who pays close attention to detail and also takes the initiative to challenge and improve existing routines and processes, while keeping the standards of quality, speed and stability Bitdefender is known for.
 What You'll Do
Develop and maintain high-availability, scalable Node.js services for sign-in and account management: passwords, one-time codes and 2FA, passkeys, and social login.
Implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows for web and mobile apps, sign-in on TVs and other devices, and partner single sign-on.
Work on token and session services (JWT/JWS), including migrations across services that can't go down.
Fix security issues and help prevent new ones.
Make our services more reliable: timeouts, idempotent operations, message queues, monitoring, and incident follow-up.
Review requirements and proposed architectures for scalability, reliability and security issues.
Work with the Product Owner and Product Manager to clarify requirements, timelines and constraints, and with QA to ensure the quality of what we ship.
Spend about 20% of your time on frontend work, helping us keep our UIs at a high quality bar.
 Our stack
Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Docker, Vue 3
What we're looking for
At least 3 years of professional backend development: services you built or maintained in production, as part of a team.
Solid JavaScript and Node.js experience. Strong backend engineers coming from Java, .NET, Go or Python are welcome too, if they're keen to switch to Node.js.
Good database fundamentals: indexes, query performance, transactions, and concurrent writes.
Web fundamentals: HTTP, cookies, sessions and tokens, CORS, and common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).
Experience debugging production issues from logs and metrics, and caring about what happens when a dependency is slow or down.
The ability to work independently.
Romanian and English.
 Nice to have
Identity or authentication experience is a plus, not a requirement: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, WebAuthn/passkeys, or identity platforms such as Keycloak, Auth0 or Cognito.
Experience building high-availability web services.
Kafka or RabbitMQ in production.
Vue 3.
 Where: our Bucharest office, hybrid, with about half of your time in the office.
